title: Function field of an integral scheme is the fraction field of an affine open
statement: Let $X$ be an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme] and $\eta$ its generic point [def-sc-generic-point], i.e. the unique point with $\overline{\{\eta\}}=X$ [lem-sc-scheme-sober]. Let $U\subseteq X$ be a nonempty affine open subset. Then $\eta\in U$, the ring $\mathcal O_X(U)$ is an integral domain, $\mathcal O_{X,\eta}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] is a field, and the germ map $\mathcal O_X(U)\to\mathcal O_{X,\eta}$, $f\mapsto f_\eta$, is injective and makes $\mathcal O_{X,\eta}$ a field of fractions of $\mathcal O_X(U)$: every nonzero $h\in\mathcal O_X(U)$ has invertible germ $h_\eta$, and every element of $\mathcal O_{X,\eta}$ is $g_\eta h_\eta^{-1}$ for some $g,h\in\mathcal O_X(U)$, $h\neq0$.
